description: This file defines the 'NetworkingTrace' class which implements diagnostic tracing and logging functionalities for networking components within the Orleans runtime. It acts as a wrapper around an ILogger instance, providing methods to begin diagnostic scopes, check if a particular log level is enabled, and perform logging operations.

classes.name: NetworkingTrace
classes.description: A sealed internal class that extends DiagnosticListener and implements ILogger to provide diagnostic and logging capabilities for networking events in Orleans.

methods.name: NetworkingTrace
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger using a provided ILoggerFactory and sets up the DiagnosticListener with the class name.

methods.name: BeginScope
methods.description: Starts a logical operation scope for logging, delegating to the internal ILogger instance.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a given log level is enabled for logging.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Performs a logging operation with specified log level, event ID, message state, exception, and formatter.
